# Sancar Games

> Sancar Games is an independent mobile game studio from Türkiye making puzzle and physics games for iPhone and iPad. Website: https://sancargames.com (Turkish) and https://sancargames.com/en/ (English). Contact: support@sancargames.com

## Games

- [Demolition Master: Tower Blast](https://sancargames.com/en/demolition-master): physics demolition game for iPhone (Turkish name: Yıkım Ustası). Choose the right machine (sledgehammer, breaker, wrecking ball, hydraulic shear, dynamite, C4) for each material and bring buildings down before time runs out. Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6823286892
- [Lantern Detective](https://sancargames.com/en/fenerli-dedektif/): detective puzzle game for children aged 7 to 11 and their families (Turkish name: Fenerli Dedektif). Light dark rooms with a lantern, collect clues and solve 20 mystery cases and 30 adventure rooms; read aloud for pre-readers. Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6827192752
- [Cat Haven: Hide and Seek](https://sancargames.com/en/cat-haven): hide-and-seek game for iPhone and iPad (Turkish name: Kedi Yuvası). Spot hiding street cats by their tails, sneak up and catch them across 30 levels and 3 difficulties. Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6832325312
- [Number Path](https://sancargames.com/en/number-path): number puzzle for iPhone and iPad (Turkish name: Sayı Yolu). Draw one path that visits every cell once and hits the red numbers on exactly that step. Coming soon.
